programme.title: The Amber May Show - From the Rattlers Playoff Win to CNN s COVID Reckoning
programme.desc:
Amber May opens today’s show with her report on the Rattlers’ 47-36 playoff victory over the Las Vegas Knight Hawks Arizona entered the game as the No 3 seed defeated the No 2 seed and earned a place in the Western Conference Championship
Then the show turns to a different kind of battle the fight over truth in American journalism
Conservative columnist Don Surber argues that modern reporters use loaded labels selective facts missing context and political double standards to shape the way Americans understand the news
Chris Bray of The Federalist examines the Fauci controversy and a familiar political playbook Delay the release of damaging information dismiss new evidence as old news change the subject appeal to authority and label serious questions as conspiracy theories
That same pattern appeared during Dana Bash’s heated CNN interview with Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr
Kennedy accused CNN of creating fear during COVID repeating government claims without enough scrutiny and attacking people who questioned public health authorities Bash pushed back invoked accepted experts and attempted to move on when Kennedy challenged CNN’s own conduct
Was Bash conducting a tough interview or defending the media institution Kennedy was criticizing
